findings.highlight: my hand covered in scratches from messing around with stuff is ill-suited.
findings.evidenceJa: 自分の手はなんとも不釣り合いだ
findings.governingReading: Against Rin’s soft hand, Shirou feels his scarred hand is painfully ill-matched.
findings.explanation: Ill-suited is left without the comparison that gives the embarrassment its relational force.

findings.highlight: She makes a malicious expression.
findings.evidenceJa: とんでもなく意地の悪い顔をしやがった
findings.governingReading: After puzzlement and a knowing sound, Rin gives him an extraordinarily wicked, teasing look.
findings.explanation: The action is detached into a subject-poor fragment and loses the escalating sequence.

findings.highlight: I have never touched a girl so strongly before.
findings.evidenceJa: あんなに強く女の子と触れあったコトも今までなかった
findings.governingReading: Shirou has never before had such intense or close physical contact with a girl.
findings.explanation: Touched so strongly suggests force or pressure instead of emotional intensity and intimacy.

findings.highlight: you really do show you feelings on your face
findings.evidenceJa: ほんと顔にでるのね
findings.governingReading: Rin says Shirou’s feelings really do show on his face.
findings.explanation: Your is mistyped as you.

findings.highlight: Tohsaka puts a book on the table.
findings.evidenceJa: どこに隠し持っていたのか、遠坂はテーブルに一冊の本を持ち出す
findings.governingReading: Rin produces a book from wherever she had kept it concealed and sets it on the table.
findings.explanation: The unexplained concealed provenance disappears, flattening the reveal.

findings.highlight: It’s not something a full Master needs
findings.evidenceJa: 一人前のマスターには必要ないもの
findings.governingReading: An accomplished or fully qualified Master does not need the beginner’s aid.
findings.explanation: Full Master suggests ontological completeness rather than ordinary competence.

findings.highlight: Instead of bringing the actual heroic spirit, it made a class similar to the spirit and called it into that.
findings.evidenceJa: 英霊そのものをひっぱってくるより、その英霊に近い役割を作っておいて、そこに本体を呼び出す
findings.governingReading: The Grail prepares a role or vessel suited to a Heroic Spirit, then calls the original into it.
findings.explanation: The English makes the class resemble the spirit, leaves the agent as it, and blurs the prepared-container mechanism.

findings.highlight: it’s easier to prepare a case for them in advance
findings.evidenceJa: 予め“筐”を用意しておいた方がいい
findings.governingReading: To summon a spirit across ages, a containing vessel or frame is prepared in advance.
findings.explanation: Case is a literal dictionary choice that does not convey the technical vessel concept.

findings.highlight: Each class has their own special characteristics
findings.evidenceJa: これらのクラスはそれぞれ特徴がある
findings.governingReading: Each class has its own distinctive traits.
findings.explanation: Singular each class takes plural their in a formally expository sentence.

findings.highlight: divine spirits falling to the rank of spirits
findings.evidenceJa: 神霊が精霊に落ちる
findings.governingReading: A divine spirit deprived of faith falls into the category of a nature spirit.
findings.explanation: Generic spirits removes the contrast between 神霊 and 精霊.

findings.highlight: if he was originally a powerful hero
findings.evidenceJa: 元が強力な英雄だったら
findings.governingReading: If the forgotten figure was originally a powerful hero, some ability may remain.
findings.explanation: The paragraph shifts abruptly from plural heroes to unsupported masculine singular.

findings.highlight: The heroes from the age of gods have special Noble Phantasms just because of that
findings.evidenceJa: 神代の英雄たちはそれだけで特殊な宝具を持っている
findings.governingReading: Heroes from the Age of Gods possess exceptional Noble Phantasms by virtue of that provenance.
findings.explanation: Just because of that leaves the causal referent vague and makes the explanation sound dismissive.

findings.highlight: the symbol that the Servant used in their life
findings.evidenceJa: その英霊が生前使っていたシンボル
findings.governingReading: A Noble Phantasm is the emblematic object used by the Heroic Spirit during life.
findings.explanation: Servant projects the post-summoning role backward into life, while “in their life” is unidiomatic.

findings.highlight: I don’t know what history it has
findings.evidenceJa: あれがどんな曰くを持っているか知らない
findings.governingReading: Rin does not know the legend, provenance, or storied associations attached to Saber’s weapon.
findings.explanation: History is too generic to carry the legendary pedigree relevant to identifying its owner.

findings.highlight: cannot match powerful spells or divine mysteries
findings.evidenceJa: 強力な魔術、神秘には太刀打ちできない
findings.governingReading: Heroic Spirits alone cannot contend with powerful magecraft or Mystery.
findings.explanation: Divine is inserted and Mystery is treated as a plural object, altering a Fate-specific technical category.

findings.highlight: are close to the level of sorcery
findings.evidenceJa: ほとんど魔法の域に近い
findings.governingReading: Legendary holy and demonic swords approach the domain of Magic.
findings.explanation: Sorcery collapses the work’s explicit distinction between magecraft and true Magic.

findings.highlight: dragons which are the most powerful fantasia race
findings.evidenceJa: 最強の幻想種である竜
findings.governingReading: Dragons are the strongest of the Phantasmal Species.
findings.explanation: Fantasia race is a malformed literal rendering of a defined setting term.

findings.highlight: shoes that run far and wide
findings.evidenceJa: 万里を駆ける靴
findings.governingReading: The examples include shoes capable of traversing ten thousand ri, an image of immense range.
findings.explanation: Far and wide removes the concrete legendary scale.

findings.highlight: the battle between Servants is concentrated in the battle between the Noble Phantasms
findings.evidenceJa: サーヴァントの戦いは、この宝具のぶつかり合いにあると言っても過言じゃない
findings.governingReading: It is no exaggeration to say Servant combat centers on clashes between Noble Phantasms.
findings.explanation: The repeated battle between construction is malformed and obscures the tactical thesis.

findings.highlight: one swing will even destroy a mountain
findings.evidenceJa: その一振りで山をも断つ
findings.governingReading: One stroke of the named weapon cuts through a mountain.
findings.explanation: Destroy replaces the defining cutting feat with generic annihilation.

findings.highlight: identify the Servant from intuition
findings.evidenceJa: 直感でサーヴァントを判断できる
findings.governingReading: With experience Shirou can judge a Servant intuitively without the book.
findings.explanation: Identify suggests discovering identity rather than assessing displayed status or capability.

findings.highlight: Once all the other Masters are dead
findings.evidenceJa: 他のマスターたちが倒れているにしろ
findings.governingReading: On the final day, Rin and Shirou must fight whether the other Masters have been defeated or remain active.
findings.explanation: Dead narrows defeated to death, while once invents a completed precondition instead of one side of a whether-or alternative.

findings.highlight: Soit’ll be easier if you don’t think of me as human
findings.evidenceJa: だからわたしを人間と見ないほうが楽よ
findings.governingReading: Rin warns that it will be easier for Shirou not to regard her as a person to whom he becomes attached.
findings.explanation: A missing space fuses So and it’ll.
